## Descriptions (PENDING Rule-8)

**Short (~50 words):**
Timeless Resurfacing restores bathrooms across Sydney without the cost and mess of replacement.
Bath and tile resurfacing, shower regrouting and silicone replacement, backed by workmanship
warranties of up to 5 years. Send photos, get your quote within 24 hours. Phone 0451 110 154.

**Medium (~120 words):**
Timeless Resurfacing is a Sydney bathroom resurfacing and regrouting specialist. We restore
baths, wall and floor tiles, vanities and benchtops to a fresh gloss finish, and re-do tired
shower grout with cement or epoxy systems, at a fraction of the cost of ripping everything out.
Every service carries its own honest workmanship warranty, up to 5 years on resurfacing, because
different materials genuinely last different lengths of time. Quoting is simple: send a few
photos through our website and you'll have a fixed quote within 24 hours, valid for 7 days. We
service all of Greater Sydney, we're fully insured with $10M public liability, and your rights
under Australian Consumer Law always apply in full. Call or text 0451 110 154.

**Long (~250 words):** use the medium version + append: paragraph on services (bath resurfacing,
tile resurfacing walls/floors, vanity and benchtop resurfacing, shower regrouting cement/epoxy,
silicone replacement, chip repairs) + paragraph on who we serve (homeowners, landlords and
property managers, real-estate agencies preparing rentals, Airbnb hosts) + the CTA. Draft at
submission time per directory limit; same voice, no "written", no "guarantee", NO prices.
